literal_cases.scope: Pre-change diagnostic cases; synthetic literal references, not independent natural-image relevance judgments
literal_cases.policy: Typed numeric intent must agree with a nearby matching document identifier. Bare numbers, years, quantities and mismatched types must not receive a new identifier boost. Existing exact mixed-code behavior is retained. No parameter tuning on the 357-query diagnostic set.

coordinator_interruption.cause: Concurrent progress inspection held a read lock during coordinator commit
coordinator_interruption.recovery: Identical command resumes remaining queries; original log preserved; no further live database inspections

partial_implementation_run.reason: Static compatibility review caught valid IPv4:port literals being excluded by the new numeric-punctuation guard. No weight/threshold tuning. Add endpoint regression and rerun full evaluation in a new directory.

limitations: Query judgments are previously inspected and incomplete; unknown candidates are not negative labels.
Synthetic literal diagnostics are authored specifications, not general OCR/retrieval accuracy.
The first explicit typed identifier is a conservative heuristic. Missing/corrupt identifiers or documents beginning with cross-references can still fail.
Only English/French/Arabic marker vocabulary; this does not fix general cross-language semantic candidate retrieval.
Sequential resident measurements include startup/restarts and uncontrolled host load. Do not interpret timing differences as isolated algorithm cost.
Native inference evaluated on macOS with 16 GiB RAM, not on 8 GiB hardware or native Windows/Linux. Existing rerankers were not retrained or evaluated against new evidence.
